parsed.rationale: All four records are empty interfaces (fields_or_signature: [], shared_field_count: 2 shared structural slots) spread across four packages — Playback, Wallpaper, MusicShareKit, and Analytics — with no test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags. A dedicated `Analytics` package already exists at `Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/AnalyticsEvent.swift` and already defines `AnalyticsEvent`, making it the natural canonical parent protocol. The three domain-specific variants (`PlaybackAnalyticsEvent`, `QualityAnalyticsEvent`, `RequestLineAnalyticsEvent`) should inherit from `AnalyticsEvent` rather than independently redeclaring structurally identical empty marker protocols, allowing call sites that only need the base contract to depend on the `Analytics` package alone.
